# Punt AST: Player Targets

**Summary.** The punt AST target list for our league is very thin. Our data has only three tagged fits: Khaman Maluach, Aaron Nesmith and Tari Eason. All three are 0 to 2 USD end-of-draft or waiver players, so this build has no cheap source of assists to fall back on. If you punt assists, commit on purpose early. Then use these late picks for blocks, rebounds and steals, and check your threes, steals and FT% every week, because the data gives almost no proof that these three help there.

## How thin the list is

Only three players in our data are tagged as punt AST fits. None of them is a real core piece. Maluach is valued at 2 USD on Yahoo and 0 USD on ESPN. Nesmith and Eason are valued at 0 USD on both sites. Nesmith and Eason both rank outside the 144 players our league drafts. So the whole target list sits in the last round or on waivers. ([Khaman Maluach](../profiles/players/khaman-maluach.md), [Aaron Nesmith](../profiles/players/aaron-nesmith.md), [Tari Eason](../profiles/players/tari-eason.md))

This matters because assists are scarce late. Big assist players are rare late in drafts. Assists are also very hard to find on waivers. If your punt plan fails in week 3, you cannot rebuild assists from the wire. Decide on the punt before the auction or early in it, not halfway through. ## What punting assists costs you

Low-assist players often struggle in threes, steals and FT%. When you punt assists, check those three categories on your roster. One category comes free: punting assists brings turnovers down automatically. In our 9-cat H2H that gives you an edge in TO most weeks. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

FT% is also one of the scarcest categories late in drafts, next to points and assists. A punt AST team that waits on FT% risks losing it as well. If you also want to win FT%, pay for good free throw shooters in the early and middle rounds. The late targets below will not supply it. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1822), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

## The three targets, category by category

Khaman Maluach is a 1 to 2 USD last-round flyer for blocks and rebounds. Our data shows nothing for him in 3PTM, ST or FT%. Treat him as a blocks pick that does not help the categories a punt AST build usually loses. His value depends on starting at center over Ighodaro and playing minutes in the mid 20s. If Ighodaro keeps the job, cut him or treat him as a waiver-level stash. ([Khaman Maluach](../profiles/players/khaman-maluach.md))

Aaron Nesmith projects about 1.6 assists, which is weak for a wing. That is why he fits this build. Our data gives no numbers for his threes, steals or FT%. His case rests on FG% climbing from 41 percent back into the 48 to 50 percent range next to Haliburton. Experts say that could make him a top 100 player. Pay 1 USD at most. Leaving him on waivers and watching him is the better plan. ([Aaron Nesmith](../profiles/players/aaron-nesmith.md))

Tari Eason averages about 1.5 assists, which is weak for a G/F. He is the only target whose profile mentions steals, along with rebounds from a wing. His three-point shooting and FG% still need to recover, so he is not yet a safe 3PTM source. Our data does not mention his FT%. He cost 2 USD in our auction last season and is a 1 USD pick at most now. His upside needs an injury to Durant or Jabari Smith. He has a weak 10-game schedule in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, so he is a weaker hold into March. ([Tari Eason](../profiles/players/tari-eason.md))

## Where the experts disagree

The notes pull in two directions on assists. One view says points, assists and FT% are the scarcest categories later in drafts, so if you miss them early, you can simply punt them. The other view says points and assists are very hard to find in good volume late, so you should secure them early. It adds that assists are an important category and nearly impossible to fix on waivers. For our league, the practical answer is to choose at the start. Either buy assists early in the auction or punt them on purpose. Do not end up punting by accident after a low-assist early pick. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1822), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=799), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1073), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1284))

## What to do and what to check

On draft day (2026-10-18), spend no more than 1 to 2 USD on any of these three. Use your bigger budget on early players who bring threes, steals and FT%, because these targets do not cover those categories. Maluach and Eason are reasonable last picks. Nesmith can stay on waivers.
